keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Philadelphia Union 1, Toronto FC 0. Cavan Sullivan (Philadelphia Union) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Indiana Vassilev.
Goal! Philadelphia Union 2, Toronto FC 0. Quinn Sullivan (Philadelphia Union) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Jovan Lukic (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Philadelphia Union 2, Toronto FC 1. Josh Sargent (Toronto FC) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Djordje Mihailovic with a cross following a corner.
First Half ends, Philadelphia Union 2, Toronto FC 1.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Andrew Rick replaces Andre Blake.
Second Half begins Philadelphia Union 2, Toronto FC 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Indiana Vassilev (Philadelphia Union).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Toronto FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Philadelphia Union 3, Toronto FC 1. Cavan Sullivan (Philadelphia Union) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Quinn Sullivan following a fast break.
Delay in match because of an injury Zane Monlouis (Toronto FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Dániel Sallói replaces Alejandro Piedrahita.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Theo Corbeanu replaces Lewis Morgan.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Matheus Pereira replaces Zane Monlouis because of an injury.
Jonathan Osorio (Toronto FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Philadelphia Union 4, Toronto FC 1. Bruno Damiani (Philadelphia Union) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Niklas Dorsch replaces Markus Cimermancic.
Delay in match because of an injury Josh Sargent (Toronto FC).
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Ben Bender replaces Jovan Lukic.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Emilio Aristizábal replaces Josh Sargent because of an injury.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Ezekiel Alladoh replaces Bruno Damiani.
Ben Bender (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Malik Jakupovic replaces Cavan Sullivan because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Jonathan Osorio (Toronto FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Emilio Aristizábal (Toronto FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Toronto FC. Derrick Etienne replaces Jonathan Osorio because of an injury.
Substitution, Philadelphia Union. Alejandro Bedoya replaces Quinn Sullivan.
